hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southern Asia, island in the Indian Ocean, south of India || mostly low, flat to rolling plain; mountains in south-central interior || strategic location near major Indian Ocean sea lanes; Adam's Bridge is a chain of limestone shoals between the southeastern coast of India and the northwestern coast of Sri Lanka; geological evidence suggests that this 50-km (31-mi) bridge once connected India and Sri Lanka; ancient records seem to indicate that a foot passage was possible between the two land masses until the 15th century, when the land bridge broke up in a cyclone || Resources: limestone, graphite, mineral sands, gems, phosphates, clay, hydropower, arable land || Exports: garments, tea, precious stones, used rubber tires, rubber products (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly low, flat to rolling plain; mountains in south-central interior || Southern Asia, island in the Indian Ocean, south of India

climate.excerpt: tropical monsoon; northeast monsoon (December to March); southwest monsoon (June to October) || occasional cyclones and tornadoes

economy.excerpt: economic contraction in 2022-23 marked by increased poverty and significant inflation; IMF two-year debt relief program following 2022 sovereign default; structural challenges from non-diversified economy and rigid labor laws; heavy dependence on tourism receipts and remittances || Exports: garments, tea, precious stones, used rubber tires, rubber products (2023) || Industries: processing of rubber, tea, coconuts, tobacco and other agricultural commodities; tourism; clothing and textiles; mining
